record.rationale:
Transfers supported native Calc cells, formula source, sparse patterns and geometry across the worker boundary; XML remains the durable representation. This is local browser integration infrastructure; no native LibreOffice file ownership or semantic parity is claimed.
AQF9AG finalizes document import before exposing the decoded model. Existing edit-text reconstruction uses the document text bridge and invalidates cached import positions after external cell-store mutation; the browser transfer format remains unchanged.
responsibilities: Transfers supported native Calc cells, formula source, sparse patterns and geometry across the worker boundary; XML remains the durable representation.

Worker snapshots retain source number-format definitions and restore each native formatter key in the destination realm. Merge anchors rebuild the native overlap flags before ODS import adoption or export.
Preserves ordered native outline groups and independent control visibility in the ephemeral worker transport.
The browser transfer uses native edit paragraphs and spans with automatic text style definitions. Earlier transfers with a plain edit-cell string remain readable.
Transfers the ODF named theme and style-owned complex color through the Worker boundary.
Carries the cell frame direction and Normal direction through the Worker alongside its ODF style records.
Transfers sheet protection options and both stored XLSX hash representations across realms.
Transfers the stored digest bytes and native primary/secondary algorithm identities in addition to OOXML data.
Transfers native enhanced protection ranges and verifier metadata between realms.

J0Z0KF worksheet pane checkpoint. Transfers per-sheet split modes, absolute fixed indices, viewport origins and the active pane. The isolated Worker reader rejects malformed geometry before document adoption.
Transfers optional native sheet group flags across the same detached Worker graph as the active sheet and pane positions.
